title: Anchor drop impact on a subsea pipeline: soil penetration + local dent chain

E7.reason: No full-scale or flume anchor-drop-on-pipeline test data exist in this worktree; DNV-RP-F107 itself is a licensed document whose tables were not verified verbatim here. Only analytic anchors (rebound, bearing capacity, ring-squash limit load, dent-energy scaling, energy closure) are claimed.
